runSummary.stalePolicy: LIVE eligibility requires real source verification; touching timestamps is not verification. Existing records keep their own verifiedAt unless their public detail was actually reopened or otherwise reconfirmed.
runSummary.note: Fresh 11.9.2026 21:18 sweep actually searched 11 source families: Profesia, direct-company careers, LinkedIn Jobs public index, Worki, Brigada.sk, Kariera/Zoznam, Praca za rohom, Pretlak/StartupJobs/WordPress Jobs, Upwork, Reddit/WordPress communities and Facebook public indexing. No new promotion-grade unique hit cleared location, language, qualification, skill and ranking gates. Strongest fresh BA candidates were PPA CONTROLL IT specialist (direct company, 1700 EUR, Bratislava; AJ B1 plus server/network/infrastructure scope), PRIMA RE GROUP IT Support Specialist (1700 EUR, Bratislava; intermediate English, VŠ II, VPN/CCTV/security scope and travel to accommodation sites), Grafton Office Manager (1750-2000 EUR, Bratislava; active English required) and Lidl Junior Facility Management Consultant (2000 EUR, Bratislava; fluent English or German plus technical/project experience). Facebook public indexing produced 0 concrete verifiable hiring posts.

developmentBacklogAdded.title: Education-level equivalency gate
developmentBacklogAdded.reason: Extract mandatory education level and compare it against the candidate's evidenced qualification before ranking or alerting. Distinguish VŠ I, VŠ II, maturita and optional education so attractive technical roles such as PRIMA RE do not consume application time when a formal degree gate is not met.

developmentBacklogAdded.title: Agency client transparency confidence
developmentBacklogAdded.reason: For agency listings where the actual employer or industry is hidden, reduce fit confidence until client context is known. This prevents over-ranking generic office/support roles where language intensity, workplace culture or technical environment cannot be verified before application.
